shots: Establish Paraane Central Resident Hall by day
Residents gather as lockdown doors fail to close
Asana recognizes Anaadhi from age-twelve escape file
Anaadhi says Asana was gate guard
ANAADHI: You were the gate guard.
Asana asks who brought police-custody subject
ASANA: Who brought a police-custody subject here?
Asana says she did not stop him
ASANA: You did not stop him.
AARATHI: That is why I am an investigator, not a wall.
Anaadhi says system did not accept surrender
ANAADHI: Your system did not accept it.
Resident asks if he killed people in forest
RESIDENT: Are you the one who killed people in the forest?
Aarathi recognizes this is not planned controlled statement room
Second resident asks why he was brought
SECOND RESIDENT: Why did you bring him here?
Second resident asks to save us
Anaadhi says do not expect to be saved by me
ANAADHI: Do not expect to be saved by me.
Anaadhi says if Paraane turns you into file ask questions
ANAADHI: If Paraane turns you into a file, ask questions.
Anaadhi says if police arrest you ask reason
ANAADHI: If police arrest you, ask for the reason.
Anaadhi says if given medicine ask explanation
ANAADHI: If they give medicine, ask for an explanation.
Anaadhi says ask him to answer for seventeen murders
ANAADHI: But ask me to answer for the seventeen murders I committed.
AARATHI: Anaadhi, is this statement voluntary?
Anaadhi says seventeen people could not
Anaadhi says he will not stop now
ANAADHI: I will not stop now.
Manire moves beside frightened child, prioritizing care
ASANA: Let us clear the hall.
Anaadhi says every decision about residents was made without them
ANAADHI: You made every decision about them without them.
Anaadhi says discussion about him should happen in front of them
ANAADHI: Now let the discussion about me happen in front of them.
Exact end: residents remain not supporters but witnesses
